name: Goblin Sponsorship
summary: At the Shimmering Flats, Baron Revilgaz's regards reach Pozzik with the Fuel Regulator Blueprints. The Baron invites Pozzik to ask for anything he needs.

sections.title: Regards for Pozzik
sections.body: Baron Revilgaz sends you to the Shimmering Flats with the Fuel Regulator Blueprints and his regards for Pozzik. The Baron says Pozzik should ask if he ever needs anything. Revilgaz waits to hear that Pozzik breaks the track record.

sections.title: Improving the Design
sections.body: Pozzik had hoped the regulator would already be assembled. Instead, he sees a chance to improve its design from the ground up. He plans to sketch new schematics, build the part and have it installed soon.

faq.q: Who sends you with the blueprints?
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz sends you from Booty Bay with his regards for Pozzik.

faq.q: Who receives the fuel regulator blueprints?
aliases: where do i take the blueprints
faq.answer: Pozzik receives the Fuel Regulator Blueprints on the Shimmering Flats.

faq.q: What does Baron Revilgaz hope to hear?
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz waits for news that Pozzik breaks the track record.
Before this delivery, you fetched the blueprints for Revilgaz. The next step is The Eighteenth Pilot.
